x: With the retirement from athletics of Colin Church (Walton AC) at the ripe old age of 18, all the local papers tipped Steve Badgery (Mitcham) for an easy win, although our own John Bicourt had beaten both these fine runners in the previous North Surrey League race.

John Bicourt moved up to take a very respectable 7th place again beating his local rival Steve Badgery from Mitcham. Adrian made no further progress and finished 24th lacking the necessary finishing fire to take him past the six runners all within striking distance.

This race ended in a great win for Steve Badgery (Mitcham) over Gordon Pirie's miling protege John Rix (SLH). It must have been quite a bind for our Adrian Major (5th last year) knowing that he was quite capable of giving one or both of these a fright, had he been fitter.
